cards.name: Wave Value Generator
cards.summary: Rhythmic oscillation: by default it pulses the layer's scale (through a Transform effect, Uniform Scale) as a sine between about 40% and 100% with a 2 s period, starting at 70% at the in point, peaking at 0.5 s and bottoming at 1.5 s. The Transform effect's anchor/position are left at the layer centre, so on text (and shape) layers the pivot lands far from the content (near the comp's bottom-right corner in the test) and the text slides toward that corner as it shrinks. An 'Output' slider exposes the same wave so other properties can be linked to it.
use_for: breathing pulse on icons or a call-to-action
hard two-size jump on a graphic (Waveform 2 = Square)
drive another property (opacity, position) from the 'Output' slider
avoid: 'Frequency' is really the period in seconds (bigger = slower)
The default shrinks to 40%: set 'Value Offset' to 0 and 'Amplitude' to about 5 for a subtle pulse
Preset maths quirk: for Triangle (3) 'Frequency' scales the height and the period stays 2 s; for Saw (4) the ramp height is 'Frequency'/2 x 'Amplitude'

On text and shape layers the scale pivots off the content (unlike Scale Bounce, the Transform effect is not re-centred): set the Transform 'Anchor Point' and 'Position' to toComp(anchorPoint), or use it on a precomp or solid
cards.duration_note: No keyframes: expression-driven for the whole layer, timed from the layer in point (time - inPoint), not from comp.time. The wave starts at the layer in point plus 'Time Offset'.

cards.name: Bloom - brights+darks
cards.summary: Soft diffusion bloom: Box Blur (radius 3) softens the layer, then two Calculations passes blend the layer's own sharp original back over it at 50% Second Layer Opacity: 'Calculations/brighten' in Screen (lifts and glows highlights) and 'Calculations/darken' in Overlay (restores contrast in the darks). Reads like a Pro-Mist filter.
use_for: taming harsh digital sharpness in trailers
avoid: Radius 3 px is subtle at 1080p: raise 'Blur Radius' to 10-30
Softens on-screen text: apply under titles
Does nothing beyond the blur if 'Second Layer' does not point at the layer itself after applying: check it
cards.duration_note: No keyframes: a static look for the whole layer.
cards.scripting: Static look, no keyframes: applyPreset at any comp.time. Apply with AdobeBridge ae_lib.jsx preset(layer, comp, file, time) (deselects other layers, selects the target, sets comp.time, calls layer.applyPreset(new File(file))). Calculations 'Second Layer' is a layer parameter that is stored as 0 in the .ffx; after applying, check it points at the layer itself, or the bloom does nothing. The instances are renamed ('(Calculations)', or TAB-prefixed 'Calculations/brighten' and 'Calculations/darken'), so find them by match name: for each effect e in layer.property('ADBE Effect Parade') with e.matchName == 'ADBE Calculations', e.property('ADBE Calculations-0006').setValue(layer.index). The blur is the legacy 'ADBE Box Blur' (Box Blur, _Obsolete category, same controls as Fast Box Blur), not 'ADBE Box Blur2'. Apply to the footage or a precomp, not an adjustment layer. 'Second Layer Opacity' (0-1, 0.5 as shipped) sets the strength; 'Blending Mode' is 11 = Screen (brighten) and 15 = Overlay (darken), with menu separators counted; Fast Box Blur 'Blur Radius' sets the spread. Preset file: C:/Program Files/Adobe/Adobe After Effects 2026/Support Files/Presets/Image - Creative/Bloom - brights+darks.ffx
